description: The whole US Treasury curve in one call, 3M bill to 30Y bond with daily closes. Points are market prices: current or an hour behind according to the connected account, and a note instead of numbers without one.

fresh.description: Set true to ask for the live view of this one call, for 5 credits, where the connected account otherwise receives it an hour behind. Accepted and free where the account is already live. No effect without a key.

name: get_treasury_curve
title: The whole Treasury curve
